description.value: The Crow & Gate holds the distinction of being BC's first neighbourhood pub, having opened in 1972 in rural Yellow Point south of Nanaimo. Its Tudor-style architecture and sprawling English gardens attract visitors from around the world, and well-behaved leashed dogs are welcome on the patio. The pub even fields helicopter landings on its back field during good weather, hinting at the kind of off-the-beaten-path character a touring cyclist will appreciate.

address.value: 2313 Yellow Point Road, Nanaimo, British Columbia V9X 1W5, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://crowandgate.ca/ successfully fetched and confirms this is a real, operating pub. Key facts: address 2313 Yellow Point Road, Nanaimo BC V9X 1W5 matches OSM street address; phone 250-722-3731 and email info@crowandgate.ca are provided on the website though absent from OSM tags. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null. The website says 'Nanaimo' as the municipality while the OSM community field says 'Ladysmith' — Yellow Point is an unincorporated rural area between the two, but the pub's own address uses Nanaimo.
concerns: OSM community field says 'Ladysmith' but the pub's own website lists its address as Nanaimo, BC; Yellow Point is an unincorporated area between the two — the OSM community tag may be assigned by proximity rather than official municipality.
OSM has no phone number recorded; website lists 250-722-3731.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating pub with a live website, confirmed address, and clear evidence of being open to the public. A notable historic stop for touring cyclists in the Yellow Point area.
enrichment_extras.notes: 19+ establishment only — no minors permitted in pub or on patio. Dog-friendly patio (leashed, short non-retractable leash required). No reservations accepted; first come, first served seating.
